options: Labour-intensive, with many workers earning modest pay for cheap raw produce

options: Undercounts real work — street trade, backyard workshops and home businesses sustain millions

questions.question: The "raw-in-your-hands" test identifies work as primary when the job ends with:

All sectors have equal shares of both
